wish: someone should make a tool that converts fountain screenplays to PDF
spec:
Type, paste or open a .fountain file and see it laid out as a standard screenplay: scene headings, action, character, parentheticals, dialogue, dual dialogue, transitions, title page.
Save as PDF prints on US Letter in 12pt Courier with industry margins, page breaks and page numbers; the draft is kept on this device.
It does not number scenes, add MORE/CONT'D across page breaks, or upload anything.

type.text:
INT. KITCHEN - NIGHT

Mary pours coffee.

MARY
(quietly)
It is late.

CUT TO:

notes: PDF via the browser's print dialog (Save as PDF); no network needed.
